message.content: Nope, not at all. Each drone has its own charging connector, and they’re all different. You can’t just plug any drone into any pad—it’s like trying to fit a square peg into a round hole. That’s why we’ve got a bunch of different pads set up at each site, one for each type of drone. It’s a pain to keep track of, especially when a drone’s battery’s about to die and you’ve got to rush it to the right pad.
